title: Pirates of Charleston: Pirate Adventures and River cruises
includes: All water cannons are accessible to the crew
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the Charleston area’s only “On the Water” Pirate Adventure designed just for kids! With a lively crew aboard, the Black Ghost embarks on an exhilarating treasure-hunting journey. Ever vigilant for skallywags, the crew knows the cunning Sneaky Pete could lurk around any corner. Armed with water cannons for battle, divvying up a haul of gold and jewels, and reveling in true pirate fashion, our band of adventurers savors the rewards of authentic piracy. We sail through Charleston harbor and its nearby creeks, offering stunning views while your kids enjoy their Best Day Ever!
